rootCauses.problem: Stored conversations could not be listed
rootCauses.cause: GET returned HTTP 200 with 109 conversations; frontend rejected totals above 100. Server permits 1000. A compatible UI fix existed only in backup commit 09245b8.
rootCauses.fix: Restore validation to 1000 and fetch all bounded pages, with an empty-page guard.

rootCauses.cause: 503 is emitted before storage when provider construction fails. Main loaded .env relative to process cwd. All required project-local credentials exist and validate; no deletion evidence. A new process loads them successfully. The failed earlier process environment/cwd was not captured, so its exact configuration omission cannot be proven.
rootCauses.fix: Resolve default .env relative to project source root; retain explicit file paths and inherited-environment precedence; report configuration presence separately from HTTP liveness.

rootCauses.cause: Chat rejects before storing a turn but the frontend retained a generic pending/save-uncertain label.
rootCauses.fix: End pending state for known CHAT_NOT_CONFIGURED rejection; preserve normal retry and stored identities.

rootCauses.problem: Historical price omitted in mixed recall and current comparison
rootCauses.cause: isRecallAndVerifyRequest did not recognize What was the price we discussed; verified live in the clean candidate.
rootCauses.fix: Extend only the explicit historical interrogative pattern; reuse existing historical Q&A formatter and comparison safeguards.
